environment: pinned Node 22.23.1; repository/service/state modules bundled with synthetic dependency boundaries; no live account, network or Library write

characterization.failed_mutation_reload_pull: Existing tests preserve the pending local edit across reload and a competing cloud pull; a failed write cannot acknowledge a newer edit.
characterization.legacy_cache: An authenticated nonempty cache with no sync metadata is treated as pending (revision increments) rather than assumed clean.
characterization.stale_acknowledgement: An acknowledgement for an older revision is refused; a newer edit remains pending.
characterization.snapshot_limit: The full-replacement push now reads up to 1001 local items and refuses when the set exceeds 1000, sending no request and leaving pending intact. A test records that the previous 1000-item read would have truncated item 1001.
characterization.two_writers: Two independent full-snapshot writers are characterized as last-writer-wins: the second snapshot replaces the first and the earlier edit is lost. This is recorded as unsupported, not accepted.

safe_refusal.behavior: If the local snapshot has more than 1000 items, push returns false before calling sync_push_library. The pending revision is not cleared.
safe_refusal.test: a local snapshot over 1000 items is refused without issuing a write

supported: One writer at a time, online, sequential save/remove/reload flows
Pending local edit preserved against a competing pull and retained across reload
1001+ items refused safely before a full snapshot
unsupported: Two independent same-account writers / lost update
A larger-than-1000 library snapshot without a pagination/delta contract
limitations: Synthetic characterization only; no live Library read, write, delete or conflict observation.
The checked client contract exposes no server version/ETag/conflict token; a client-only merge cannot be called safe.
This child adds a safe refusal and policy, not broad offline/concurrent durability.
